item.title: Physicians Differ on Chronic Urticaria Prevalence
item.description: Worldwide survey shows chronic urticaria prevalence estimates differ, and physicians may underestimate sleep, activity, and impact. The post Physicians Differ on Chronic Urticaria Prevalence appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cardiovascular Disease Increases Mental Health Risk
item.description: Those with ASCVD were more likely to experience somatic symptoms (OR 1.138; 95% CI 1.069–1.212), anxiety and insomnia (OR 1.113; 95% CI 1.043–1.188), and severe depression (OR 1.173; 95% CI 1.084–1.269). The post Cardiovascular Disease Increases Mental Health Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Combines Imaging Data to Predict Stroke Mortality
item.description: AI-derived radiology phenotypes improved stroke mortality prediction, when added to structured EHR data in acute stroke admissions. The post AI Combines Imaging Data to Predict Stroke Mortality appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New Guidance Supports HPV Self-Sampling for Cervical Screening
item.description: Updated guidance supports HPV self-sampling as an effective way to increase cervical cancer screening uptake among under-screened women. The post New Guidance Supports HPV Self-Sampling for Cervical Screening appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Hidradenitis Suppurativa Patient-Reported Outcome Measures Reviewed
item.description: A review found seven hidradenitis suppurativa patient-reported key outcome measures, with HiSQOL-17 performing best across studies. The post Hidradenitis Suppurativa Patient-Reported Outcome Measures Reviewed appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Nursery Life Reshapes the Infant Microbiome
item.description: Babies rapidly share gut microbes at nursery, with peer contact shaping the infant microbiome as strongly as family by the first year of life. The post Nursery Life Reshapes the Infant Microbiome appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ACE Inhibitor Use Linked to Lower IPF Mortality
item.description: In idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, ACE inhibitor use was associated with lower all-cause mortality in propensity matched EHR cohorts. The post ACE Inhibitor Use Linked to Lower IPF Mortality appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Dasatinib Enhances Immune Activation in Philadelphia Leukaemia
item.description: Dasatinib plus blinatumomab demonstrated greater and sustained immune activation than ponatinib combinations in Ph+ acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, with marked effects on lymphocytes and natural killer cells. The post Dasatinib Enhances Immune Activation in Philadelphia Leukaemia appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Can Gut Microbiota Improve Colorectal Screening?
item.description: Gut microbiota dysbiosis may shape colorectal cancer risk, with microbial signatures emerging as non-invasive screening biomarkers. The post Can Gut Microbiota Improve Colorectal Screening? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Predicts Antidepressant Treatment Response with 97% Accuracy
item.description: Patients who responded to treatment showed increased Beta2 power, enhanced high-frequency functional connectivity, and dominant engagement of frontal brain networks. The post AI Predicts Antidepressant Treatment Response with 97% Accuracy appeared first on European Medical Journal.
